title: Voice capture + prioritization heatmap (Feb 2026)
content:
Overview:
This is a quick-capture synthesis of customer feedback collected between 2026-01-15 and 2026-02-20 from support tickets, CSM interviews, partner calls, and in-product NPS comments. Purpose: create a compact actionable list + heatmap to surface high-volume, high-impact asks for product and eng planning.

Methodology (sources):
- Support tickets exported (Jan 1 - Feb 15): ~472 tickets tagged 'latency'/'cost'/'private-deploy'
- 8 CSM interviews (mid-market + enterprise customers)
- 3 partner technical deep-dives (SI partners working on Private deployments)
- In-product feedback widget (top 10 comments for endpoint generation)
- Quick survey to 45 power-users (25 responses)
Note: counts below are approximate and include duplicates across channels.

Topline summary (one-liner):
Most frequent asks fall into two buckets: 1) clearer, prescriptive guidance to hit latency/cost SLOs (Optimize + SDK examples), and 2) smoother private deployment onboarding + auditing (VPC/KMS/rollout safety). Secondary asks: improved per-route cost observability and more granular fallback controls for model variants.

Heatmap legend (manual assessment):
- Volume = frequency of mentions across channels
- Customer impact = revenue/prod-criticality (customer reported)
- Feasibility = rough eng estimate (low/med/high) — see notes for follow-ups

Clustered themes & exemplar asks:
1) Performance, SLOs & predictable latency (Volume: HIGH, Impact: HIGH, Feasibility: MED)
  - Requests: "Guaranteed p50/p95 targets" for Dedicated routes; clearer docs to configure autoscaling policies and burst behavior.
  - Example quotes: "We need to know we won't regress during Black Friday traffic spikes" (retailAI Enterprise).
  - Concrete asks: more canned autoscale templates, early-warning latency alerts (p90 > threshold), and a 'latency SLA explainer' doc comparing hosted vs dedicated.
  - Proposed owner: eng-serving-runtime + product-dedicated.
  - Linked Jira hints: JIRA-CR-1123 (autoscale UX), JIRA-OBS-2034 (latency alerts).

2) Observability & per-route cost clarity (Volume: HIGH, Impact: MED-HIGH, Feasibility: HIGH)
  - Requests: token-level cost breakdown per route, per-model cost rollups, and the ability to export per-call billing samples for cost audits.
  - Customer ask: "We want to allocate monthly inference spend to product lines, not just accounts." (fintechCo).
  - Quick win: exportable CSV of route->model->tokens->cost for last 30/90 days (product: hosted-api + console).
  - Proposed owner: product-hosted-api + console-and-rollouts.

3) Private deployments: onboarding friction & compliance controls (Volume: MED, Impact: HIGH, Feasibility: MED)
  - Requests: clearer onboarding checklist for VPC/on-prem installs, KMS/HSM key rotation patterns, and audit-ready logs formatted for SIEM ingestion.
  - Example: "Our security team needs a step-by-step that we can hand to infra for SOC2 review" (healthtech customer).
  - Action: publish 'Private deployment quickstart for security teams' + sample terraform and audit log schema.
  - Proposed owner: product-private-deployments + security-and-compliance.

4) Model rollouts, canaries & fallback policies (Volume: MED, Impact: MED, Feasibility: MED)
  - Requests: more fine-grained traffic-shift controls (percent by customer segment), clearer automatic fallback paths (e.g., quantized variant if high-latency), and rollout analytics per cohort.
  - Note from solutions eng: several customers have built fragile home-grown fallbacks; they'd prefer a supported pattern.
  - Proposed owner: product-console-rollouts + serving-runtime.

5) Developer experience: SDK examples, streaming robustness, and function-calling reliability (Volume: MED, Impact: MED, Feasibility: HIGH)
  - Requests: streaming reconnect guidance, SDK samples for streaming in Node/Python, and reproducible examples for function/tool calling with best-practice retries.
  - Example: "SDK reconnects drop final tokens occasionally — cost and UX hit" (startupA).
  - Quick work: expand sdk-examples repo with a 'streaming pitfalls' page and a simple 'function-calling recovery' snippet. (GH PR exists: github.com/redwood-inference/sdk-examples/pull/274)

6) Redwood Optimize suggestions visibility (Volume: LOW-MED, Impact: MED, Feasibility: HIGH)
  - Requests: put Optimize suggestions inline with route configs (e.g., recommend quantization+batching for route X), plus an estimate of token-cost delta.
  - Customer ask: "If we click apply, what will our monthly bill change by?"
  - Proposed owner: product-optimize + eng-inference-ops.

Representative tickets/ask fragments (copied for context):
- "Need a retained cache option, we get identical requests from our chat UI" — (CS ticket #4821)
- "How do we set a hard per-call timeout for certain routes?" — (support thread Feb 3)
- "Can we have a granular RBAC for viewing cost on a per-product team basis?" — (enterprise account admin)

Risk flags (things that could bite us if not addressed):
- Several customers use dedicated capacity for predictable latency; if autoscaling misbehaves during demand spikes, churn risk is significant.
- Confusing documentation on private deployment networking has already delayed two pilots.
- A small but vocal set are building custom fallbacks that bypass Redwood routing — this increases support surface and makes regression debugging harder.

Prioritization heatmap (high-level guidance):
- Immediate (0-6 weeks): EXPORT per-route cost CSV, Streaming SDK reconnect snippets, Private deployment quickstart checklist (security-focused).
- Near term (6-12 weeks): Autoscale templates + latency alerting, onboarding terraform examples for private, Optimize inline suggestions MVP.
- Backlog (12+ weeks): Advanced rollout cohort analytics, RBAC-per-product cost views, retained cache feature exploration.

Concrete next steps & owners (short checklist):
- [ ] Create support KB: "Export route cost CSV" (owner: Lena Hoffman, due: 2026-03-12).
- [ ] Draft 'private deploy security quickstart' (owner: Priya Narayanan, due: 2026-03-19).
- [ ] Engineering spike: feasibility for retained cache (owner: eng-serving-runtime lead — assign after sync).
- [ ] Add streaming reconnect guide to sdk-examples (owner: Ethan Kim, PR target: 2026-03-01).
- [ ] Product: include Optimize suggestion stub in route edit page (PM: Aisha Rahman, scoping meeting 2026-03-03).

Open questions / TODOs (notes to self):
- Need a better quantification of revenue-at-risk per customer for autoscale regressions — ask RevOps for ARR mapping.
- Confirm feasibility estimate on retained cache (engineering to provide timebox of 2w/4w).
- Should we expose routing fallback config as user-editable or keep as policy controlled by SRE? Pros/cons listed in Slack thread: slack:#prod-discuss/rollouts (ref).

Appendix (raw snippets / quotes):
- "We love the performance but want explicit guidance on how to tune for 99th percentile under a steady-state burst." — Platform Lead, retailAI.
- "If you can give us a terraform example that wires KMS and S3 logs in 15 minutes, we'll proceed to PoC." — SecOps, healthtech-corp.
- "The Optimize recommendations are good; we want the confidence number and an estimated $ delta." — ML infra manager, commerceX.

Notes on fidelity: this is intentionally a condensed working doc for prioritization conversations. I'll convert high-priority items into individual tickets (support KBs, GH PRs, or JIRA tasks) once owners confirm scope.

Last updated: 2026-03-05 by Marissa Cole
Quick links: internal playbook (confluence/CS/voice-collection-playbook), ticket export snapshot (JIRA-CR-1123), related SDK PR (github.com/redwood-inference/sdk-examples/pull/274)
